CustomField.description: Org-wide master switch for the "Decline to Sign" button (#367). Default FALSE — Decline is hidden everywhere until this is explicitly turned on. When on, each template still needs its own Show_Signer_Decline__c opt-in before Decline appears on it (except source-document sends with no template, which are gated by this setting alone). Resolved live on every signing-page load (DocGenSignatureController.validateToken), not stamped at send time, so flipping this reaches already-sent, still-pending signature requests too.
CustomField.label: Show Decline Button
